order: Loop on actual producer advances, including preload/refill and same-owner marker coalescing
Ramp terminal candidate after computed control delta in the selected service slot
PC: decoded pitch increment and TVF coefficient
terminal control trigger at the actual Ramp service
hold_rule: Computed ramp deltas exclude bit17; host writes may set/clear it; runtime accepted terminal sets it. No golden accepted/blocked/marker/hold after-state is executable input.

stages.1: source initialize control, preserves original pre-pitch/pre-TVF decode inputs
stages.2: starting TVF ramp before entering running phase
stages.3: counter6 refresh after interpolation, phase advance and ROM producer, before Ramp
stages.4: selected Ramp service after source operations, before filter; delta precedes local terminal candidate

pair_order: owner TVA/source including IRQ, partner TVA/source including IRQ, then paired filter; both use updated control coefficients and incoming TVA gain
feedback: Mixer observes previous filter output; XP DSP preserves original slots; LSP SDIA return is shifted by8 and consumed in next frame
probe: three separately linked XP originals/export/consumer; same authored initial fixture, every subsequent frame advances independently; compare 202 words at all64 frames
candidate_rule: Unarmed or masked terminal calls return before arbitration and are omitted losslessly; all potentially accepted or blocked candidates still execute runtime-local arbitration.
